action.action-desc: Mr. Ruiz introduced the following bill; which was referred to the Committee on Agriculture, and in addition to the Committee on Financial Services, for a period to be subsequently determined by the Speaker, in each case for consideration of such provisions as fall within the jurisdiction of the committee concerned

form.official-title: To establish a uniform definition of rural area for all rural development programs administered by the Department of Agriculture.

section.text: This Act may be cited as the Rural Area Population Act.

section.header: Uniform definition of rural area for USDA rural development programs

subsection.text: Section 343(a)(13) of the Consolidated Farm and Rural Development Act (7 U.S.C. 1991(a)(13)) is amended—

paragraph.text: in subparagraph (A)(ii), by striking urbanized and insert urban;

subparagraph.text: by striking (F) each place it appears and inserting (D); and
in clause (i), by striking urbanized each place it appears and inserting urban;

paragraph.text: in subparagraph (E), by striking urbanized and inserting urban;

subparagraph.text: in clause (i)(II), by striking urbanized and inserting urban; and
in clause (ii), by striking consider— and all that follows and inserting consider an area described in clause (i)(I) not to be a rural area for purposes of subparagraph (A).; and

paragraph.text: by redesignating subparagraphs (D) through (I) as subparagraphs (B) through (G), respectively.

subsection.header: Conforming amendments to the Rural Electrification Act of 1936

paragraph.text: Section 13(3) of the Rural Electrification Act of 1936 (7 U.S.C. 913(3)) is amended—

subparagraph.text: in subparagraph (A), by striking (C) each place it appears and inserting (A); and
in subparagraph (B), by striking loan and inserting loan, or has had a loan, before made under.

paragraph.text: Section 203(b) of such Act (7 U.S.C. 924(b)) is amended to read as follows:

subsection.text: In this title, the term rural area shall have the meaning given the term in 343(a)(13)(A) of the Consolidated Farm and Rural Development Act (7 U.S.C. 1991(a)(13)(A)).

paragraph.text: Section 601(b)(3) of such Act (7 U.S.C. 950bb(b)(3)) is amended to read as follows:
The term rural area shall have the meaning given the term in 343(a)(13)(A) of the Consolidated Farm and Rural Development Act (7 U.S.C. 1991(a)(13)(A)).
Section 604(a)(4) of such Act (7 U.S.C. 950bb–3(a)(4)) is amended to read as follows:
The term rural area shall have the meaning given the term in 343(a)(13)(A) of the Consolidated Farm and Rural Development Act (7 U.S.C. 1991(a)(13)(A)).

subsection.text: Section 520 of the Housing Act of 1949 (42 U.S.C. 1490) is amended—

paragraph.text: by striking the first sentence and inserting the following: (a) In general.—As used in this title, the term rural area shall have the meaning given the term in 343(a)(13)(A) of the Consolidated Farm and Rural Development Act (7 U.S.C. 1991(a)(13)(A)).;
by striking For purposes of this title and inserting the following:
by striking , and the city and all that follows through year 2000; and
by adding at the end the following:

subsection.text: As used in this title, the term rural shall have the meaning given the term rural area in subsection (a).
The amendments made by this Act shall take effect 180 days after the date of the enactment of this Act.
The Secretary of Agriculture shall prescribe such rules as are necessary with respect to implementing the amendments made by this Act.
